Visible hunks: the 'Last updated' date changes from 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-05 (line 3), and one troubleshooting table row is added near head line 3552 about a provider crash loop on a pre-release macOS 27.2 build (SDK 27.2 and Date comparisons with >= / <=). The supplied base text covers only lines 1-824, which are unchanged apart from line 3. The patch excerpt for the new row is truncated and the row itself lies outside the supplied base units, so I could not see its full content.

This is documentation only. It changes no code, keys, attestation flow, wire protocol, authorization, encryption or cache behavior. The prefix-cache, SSD tier, Nemotron logprobs and cluster-batching material in the base units is unchanged context. It does not alter the T-041 cache posture, the TB-002 plaintext handling, or the add-on hold (TB-012) behavior, so I identified no new attack surface or invalidated threat-model assumption. The context row that mentions the add-on hold (docs/architecture/inference.md ~3549) is existing text.

Open question: the truncated new row could contain operational guidance, such as a workaround, that has security implications. The supplied evidence does not show that it does, and I cannot verify it. The remaining risk is low.
